rationale: Settings aligned with conservative analysis of predictor-only data (no management treatments). Reference quantile 0.75 and stress threshold 0.75 ensure focus on high-stress scenarios within the historical distribution. Max water proxy shift of 0.5 (50%) allows for significant counterfactual drought/wetness exploration without inventing irrigation data. Actionable features limited to 5 (temperature, radiation, VPD, dry days, consecutive dry days) as these are the only modifiable climate predictors. Top 8 stresses reported to capture the full spectrum of identified hazards (heat, drought, frost) present in the 167-row dataset.
